description: This file contains implementations of serializers, copiers, and base codecs for serializing and copying Dictionary<TKey, TValue> objects, including handling of key and value codecs, equality comparers, and reference tracking within the Orleans Serialization framework.

classes.name: DictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Serializer for Dictionary<TKey, TValue> implementing the IFieldCodec interface, handling serialization/deserialization with support for reference tracking and custom comparers.

classes.name: DictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Deep copier for Dictionary<TKey, TValue> implementing IDeepCopier, enabling deep copies with handling of different dictionary types and comparers.

classes.name: DictionaryBaseCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Base codec for Dictionary<TKey, TValue> implementing IBaseCodec, providing serialization and deserialization logic with capacity and comparer handling.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a Dictionary<TKey, TValue> to the buffer, including optional comparer and key-value pairs.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a Dictionary<TKey, TValue> from the buffer, reconstructing the dictionary with proper reference tracking.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Dictionary<TKey, TValue> instance with specified length, comparer, session, and placeholder reference ID.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the source dictionary, copying each key and value.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Copies data from source to target dictionary, preserving capacity and comparer.
